say:1:1130131001:1.text: Who's there? ...Ah, not Ted. No, you see I'm waiting for a merchant named Ted.
say:1:1130131001:1.source_cn: 谁？……不是塔林塔先生啊。我在等一位叫做塔林塔的商人——

say:2:1130131002:1.text: His caravan came to the Ashen Wastes, and Ted went ahead to scout the area.
say:2:1130131002:1.source_cn: 他们商队来到荒角沙漠行商，塔林塔先生先来探路。

say:3:1130131003:1.text: When he decided they could rest here, he went back to tell the others.
say:3:1130131003:1.source_cn: 他发现了我们这里可以休整，于是回去通知商队了。

say:4:1130131004:1.text: He also left a bunch of supplies with me and told me to look after them. I'll guard them until he returns!
say:4:1130131004:1.source_cn: 他还在我这里存放了不少的货物，拜托我照看好。在他回来前...
